info.title: Church Member Management API
info.description: API documentation for the Church Member Management System. Covers geographic data (provinces, districts, sectors, cellules, villages) and member management.

get.description: Returns all cellules belonging to the specified sector, ordered alphabetically.

200.description: A list of cellules for the given sector

get.description: Returns all districts belonging to the specified province, ordered alphabetically.

200.description: A list of districts for the given province

get.description: Returns a collection of all church members ordered by last name then first name.

post.description: Creates a new church member record. Returns the created member.

talent.description: IDs of talents selected (at least one required)

spiritual_gift.description: IDs of spiritual gifts selected (at least one required)

education.description: Education levels selected, each paired with its own faculty IDs

faculty.description: IDs of faculties (must belong to this entry's education_id)

department.description: Departments selected, each paired with its own church responsibility IDs

church_responsibility.description: IDs of church responsibilities (must belong to this entry's department_id)

message.example: The first name field is required.

first_name: The first name field is required.

get.description: Returns the details of a specific church member by their ID.

put.description: Updates a church member record. All fields are optional (PATCH behaviour). Returns the updated member.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the member to update

talent.description: IDs of talents selected (at least one required if provided)

spiritual_gift.description: IDs of spiritual gifts selected (at least one required if provided)

education.description: Education levels selected, each paired with its own faculty IDs

faculty.description: IDs of faculties (must belong to this entry's education_id)

department.description: Departments selected, each paired with its own church responsibility IDs

church_responsibility.description: IDs of church responsibilities (must belong to this entry's department_id)

message.example: The email must be a valid email address.

email: The email must be a valid email address.

get.description: Returns all occupations ordered alphabetically. Use this to populate the occupation multi-select on the member registration form.
Returns all talents ordered alphabetically. Use this to populate the talent multi-select on the member registration form.
Returns all spiritual gifts ordered alphabetically. Use this to populate the spiritual gift multi-select on the member registration form.
Returns all education levels ordered alphabetically. Use this to populate the education dropdown on the member registration form.

get.summary: List faculties for an education level
get.description: Returns all faculties available for the given education level, ordered alphabetically. Use this to populate the faculty multi-select on the member registration form once an education level is chosen.

parameters.name: education
parameters.description: The ID of the education level

200.description: A list of faculties for the given education level

get.summary: List church responsibilities for a department
get.description: Returns all church responsibilities available for the given department, ordered alphabetically. Use this to populate the church responsibility multi-select on the member registration form once a department is chosen.

200.description: A list of church responsibilities for the given department

get.description: Returns all departments ordered alphabetically. Use this to populate the department dropdown on the member registration form.
Returns a collection of all provinces ordered alphabetically.
Returns all sectors belonging to the specified district, ordered alphabetically.

200.description: A list of sectors for the given district

get.description: Returns all villages belonging to the specified cellule, ordered alphabetically.

200.description: A list of villages for the given cellule
